name: read_credit_card_bills
description: Read owned captured credit-card bills for a due month using the canonical Accounts calculation. Returns statement dates, calendar-month purchases, captured bill, paid, remaining and unmatched payment amounts, and open/closed state. Honors card start month; supports historical months. No bank balances or verified issuer debt. Page through nextOffset. For dated payment history use read_financial_records credit_cards history with card_id.

month.description: YYYY-MM bill due month, not purchase month.
